+"""Generate the replayable trajectory for the frozen align_blocks instance."""
+
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rcb_robowits import Session
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output/trajectory.npz")
+s = Session("align_blocks", instance="/app/instance.json")
+p = s.primitives()
+
+# The left gripper takes the first cube from (0.558, 0.163) to the line
+# between the second and third cubes, then releases it on the tabletop.
+s.reset()
+s.record_start()
+q = p["top_down_quat"](math.pi / 2)
+p["open_gripper"]("left", steps=20)
+p["move_ee"]("left", (0.558, 0.163, 0.900), q, linear=3, settle=10)
+p["move_ee"]("left", (0.558, 0.163, 0.825), q, linear=3, settle=10)
+p["close_gripper"]("left", steps=35)
+p["open_gripper"]("left", steps=20)
+p["move_ee"]("left", (0.558, 0.163, 0.800), q, linear=2, settle=8)
+p["close_gripper"]("left", steps=35)
+p["move_ee"]("left", (0.558, 0.163, 0.870), q, linear=3, settle=10)
+p["move_ee"]("left", (0.476, 0.080, 0.870), q, linear=4, max_dq=0.03, settle=10)
+p["move_ee"]("left", (0.476, 0.080, 0.798), q, linear=3, max_dq=0.03, settle=15)
+p["open_gripper"]("left", steps=25)
+p["move_ee"]("left", (0.476, 0.080, 0.900), q, linear=4, max_dq=0.03, settle=20)
+
+actions = s.record_stop()
+assert s.status()["success"], s.status()
+for trial in range(2):
+    status = s.replay(actions)
+    print(f"replay {trial + 1}: {status}", flush=True)
+    assert status["success"], status
+s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT)
+print(f"saved {len(actions)} actions to {OUT}", flush=True)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
